## Libraries {#libraries}

Each tile is keyed by the library's federation accent.

{{< include federation/_legend.md >}}

## Layers {#layers}

::: {.fed-layer-grid}
::: {.fed-layer}
<span>01</span>
### Substrate numerics
`nitrix` supplies pure JAX/XLA statistics, geometry, and registration. `niffi` connects community C/C++ kernels. `ilex` and `nimox` carry model inference, training, and neural-network modules.
:::

::: {.fed-layer}
<span>02</span>
### Data and dispatch
`tensorbids` defines the tensor-native on-disk reference. `bitsjax` gives datasets programmatic awareness, while `thrux` assembles in-memory dispatch graphs over neuroimaging containers.
:::

::: {.fed-layer}
<span>03</span>
### Composition
`entense` builds ETL and workflow paths into accelerated storage. `gramform` and `conveyant` turn formulas, commands, and typed composition into executable functions.
:::

::: {.fed-layer}
<span>04</span>
### Experience
`hyve` sits at the visualisation edge, turning composed neuroimaging data products into interpretable figures and scenes.
:::
:::

## Build Focus

This hub currently proves the full documentation loop through `nitrix` and
`tensorbids`, then scaffolds the surrounding libraries so the shared theme,
cross-library references, and federation palette can grow without fragmenting.
:::
